newsitem.title: INDONESIA: IMF says working with Russia on tax collection.
newsitem.headline: IMF says working with Russia on tax collection.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is working closely with the Russian government on solving the problem of tax collection, IMF Director-General Michel Camdessus said on Thursday.

"We are working with the Russian government and working hard to help them solve the very important problem they have, which is difficulties in collecting the revenues they have legislated," Camdessus told Reuters during an economic meeting in Jakarta.
"I hope we will be able soon to start again with our financing of this country. I hope no more than a few weeks," he said.

Asked about the situation with Russian President Boris Yeltsin following his heart operation, Camdessus said: "We don't need Mr Yeltsin to collect taxes. We need the dynamism and professionalism of his entire administration.
"When I discussed last with him, I saw him extremely committed to implement the programme we had negotiated together."
